name: AssetListItem
intent: Selectable row for a captured asset — thumbnail with an overlay slot, clamped title and subtitle, and a meta line.
when: Listing camera feeds, drone captures, timelapses or any thumbnailed record
A list selection drives a map or detail panel beside it
whenNot: Rows with no media -> use Item or a DataTable row
A rich work record with status and assignees -> use WorkItemCard

chooseOver.component: A hand-built Card with an img and a badge row
chooseOver.because: One template held three copies of this shell differing only in the thumbnail overlay and the meta line; both are slots here.

lineage.authoredBy: Extracted from the three duplicated list items in core-org-reality-capture (2026-08-25)

extracted: 80x56 thumbnail well with an overlay layer

notes: The three copies also used template-literal classNames; the component uses cn, matching the rest of the library.

props.name: thumbnail
props.description: Thumbnail image URL. Omit — or pass an asset that has none — to show `fallback` instead.

props.name: thumbnailAlt
props.description: Alt text for the thumbnail. Required whenever `thumbnail` is set.

props.name: fallback
props.description: Shown in the thumbnail well when there is no image — typically a muted lucide icon.

props.name: overlay
props.description: Rendered over the thumbnail, absolutely positioned: live pills, spinners, duration chips.

props.name: title
props.description: Primary line. Clamped to one line.

props.name: children
props.description: The meta line — a status badge and a timestamp, or any short run of facts.

props.name: ...props
props.description: All standard HTML attributes are supported.

usage: Use AssetListItem to display structured data or visualizations. This component helps users understand and interact with complex information sets.

AssetListItem is ideal for dashboards, reports, and data-heavy interfaces. Ensure data is presented clearly and consider responsive behavior for different screen sizes. Provide appropriate loading states for async data.

anatomy.description: AssetListItem is composed of the following parts:

bestPractices.title: Use consistent item spacing
bestPractices.description: Maintain uniform gaps between list items for visual rhythm.

bestPractices.title: Don't vary item spacing
bestPractices.description: Avoid inconsistent gaps that create visual confusion.

bestPractices.title: Provide loading states
bestPractices.description: Show skeleton loaders while list data is being fetched.

bestPractices.title: Don't show empty state unexpectedly
bestPractices.description: Always indicate loading vs empty to avoid confusing users.

bestPractices.title: Support keyboard navigation
bestPractices.description: Enable arrow key navigation through list items.

bestPractices.title: Don't break navigation flow
bestPractices.description: Avoid interactive elements that trap focus within items.
